name: AstroDir
tagline: A directory for discovering astrology, tarot, BaZi, I Ching and related websites and apps.
description:
AstroDir is an English and Chinese directory for discovering astrology, tarot, BaZi, I Ching, Feng Shui and related websites and apps. It brings traditional resources and AI-assisted tools into a searchable collection, with categories and descriptive notes that help visitors explore different options. People can use it to find a birth-chart tool, browse tarot resources, discover Chinese metaphysics calculators or locate learning material across these traditions. AstroDir links visitors to third-party providers, whose features, prices and terms should be checked on their own websites. Browsing the directory is free. Site owners can also choose optional paid listing or promotional services. AstroDir is useful for readers who want one starting point for finding and comparing metaphysics resources instead of collecting links from separate searches. It is a resource directory, rather than a consultation or reading service.

Watch out: this is a directory of astrology, tarot, BaZi, Feng Shui, and some AI reading products. It is not itself a chart calculator. Checked 2026-11-14.
